free.question: Is Konectr free to use?
free.answer: Yes! Konectr is free to join and use. We may offer premium features in the future, but the core experience of connecting with people will always be free.

safety.question: How do I know the people I meet are safe?
safety.answer: Every account is verified with a one-time code before it can join anything, and all meetups happen at public venues. Every report is read by a person, and repeat violations trigger our three-strike system.

introvert.question: What if I'm shy or introverted?
introvert.answer: Konectr is perfect for introverts! Since you're connecting over shared activities, there's always something to focus on besides small talk. Plus, small groups keep things comfortable.

createMeetups.question: Can I create my own meetups?
createMeetups.answer: Absolutely! You can either join existing activities or create your own. Pick a venue, set a time, and let others join you.

cities.question: What cities is Konectr available in?
cities.answer: Kuala Lumpur, for now. We're building one strong community before we expand to more Malaysian cities. Follow @konectr.app on Instagram for news on new cities.

difference.question: How is this different from Meetup or Bumble BFF?
difference.answer: Konectr focuses on real-time, spontaneous connections. No scheduling weeks ahead or swiping through profiles. Post the activity you want and meet people who want the same thing today.
